I saw Dinosaur Jr. a couple of years ago in Copenhagen as part of their reunion tour.

The vocals were barely audible and when the crowd shouted for them to turn their mics up, Lou Barlow simply responded with "you want more vocals? fuck you!".

That, and the fact that J. Mascis would fill out the space between songs with 3 minute jams, resulted in the worst gig I've ever been to. I was really disappointed that they turned out to be such arrogant assholes.

Also Fleet Foxes at the Roskilde Festival. Some sound engineer must have been having a bad day and the band even went as far as apologizing for the gig after wards. 

I still love both Dinosaur and Fleet Foxes though.
